Definition: Tirtsah, a place in Palestine; also an Israelitess
BiblicalUsage: Tirzah = "favourable"; n pr f; 1) one of the 7 daughters of Zelophehad the son of Hepher of the tribe of Manasseh; n pr loc; 2) one of the kingdoms on the west of the Jordan conquered by Joshua and the Israelites; 3) a Canaanite city, later capital of the northern kingdom of Israel
